retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-inspired layout featuring bold, liquid-style psychedelic typography over a dark, multi-exposure portrait with a high-contrast blue and orange color scheme.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, moody photographic portrait of a male figure with a double-exposure effect, framed by a thick blue border containing vibrant orange, liquid-style psychedelic lettering at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant orange typography against a deep navy blue header
Dark, low-key photography framed by a solid color border
Repetition of the subject's face through double exposure
Contrast between organic, fluid letterforms and structured rectangular framing
coreInvariants: High-contrast orange-on-blue color palette for the header
Rounded rectangular frame for the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame, appearing multiple times in a layered, overlapping composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized orange name at the top serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold orange text, moves down to the secondary red text, and then settles into the dark, layered photographic portraits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows within the photograph create significant internal negative space, while the blue border provides external structure.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the typography contrasts with the low-value, high-contrast shadows of the photography.
